# Header/footer block recovery controls

Original XML packages generated by `tools/story_block_recovery_fixture.py`
using Python's standard library and the existing independent image-recovery
builder. Each includes styled header/footer paragraphs and tables plus body
images, a table and numbering. Three variants insert an unsupported OMML display
equation into the header, footer or both; the healthy control omits it.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.10 (headers/footers) and 22.1 (Office Math) supply the
constructs. Schema validation confirms these are valid packages. Before this
change the unsupported block discarded its whole header/footer. Read-only
recovery must retain supported siblings, report the missing block and preserve
all original bytes. The equation itself is still omitted; this is not math
support. Browser pixel/geometry comparisons use the matched healthy control,
not the reference application's rendering of an equation. Relationship, invalid-story and layout
failures can still have wider recovery boundaries.
